buildSourceNote: Build 132 carries v1.1.0-rc.8, found while driving one real vehicle (JC-41368 / KA32AA5828) into pre-invoice: the Service Advisor clicked Acknowledge QC Pass, job_card_master.live_status moved to PRE_INVOICE_READY, and the screen did not change. GET /api/job-cards does not read MySQL - it serves an in-memory snapshot built by syncLoad() at boot - and only the floor allocation bridge ever patched that snapshot, so every engine stage write committed to the database while cache-fed screens kept rendering the previous stage. refreshCachedJobCard is now exposed as syncCachedJobCard and called after all 18 committed job_card_master.live_status writes across the QC, floor and billing engines. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
